description: This job script submits a two-stage Geant4 simulation and analysis pipeline to a Slurm scheduler. The first stage runs a detector simulation array (200 batches) using Geant4 and ROOT, and the second stage merges the output ntuples and performs physics analysis to generate a summary report.

workload_class.step_description: Submit a Slurm job array of 200 batches to run Geant4 detector simulation (using module load geant4/11.2 and root/6.30.06) with a random seed per batch, and validate the output with ROOT macro check_ntuple.C.
Submit a Slurm job that waits for the simulation array to complete, then merges ntuple files with hadd, runs a ROOT analysis macro, and generates a summary report using a Python script.
